description: **Scaffolding a releasable member whose merge bases are not yet in its releasable's state directory explains why.** A member scaffolded while its bases lived in its own `.rlsbl/bases/` is refused once on its next scaffold; the refusal used to claim the member was scaffolded before merge-base tracking, and now says a member's bases live in `.rlsbl-monorepo/releasables/<name>/bases/<member path>/` and it has none there yet. The remedy it names is unchanged: `mkdir -p` that directory and re-run `rlsbl scaffold`, which rebuilds each base from its last scaffold commit.
